problem: Claire has a bag of candies with $12$ assorted flavors. In how many ways can Claire pick $3$ flavors of candies?

feedback.problem: In a high school, eight players enter trials for the soccer team. In how many ways can the coach select four players to add to the team?
feedback.worked_solution:
The number of combinations of $n$ objects taken $r$ at a time is given by the formula

$$
{}_{n}{C}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!\,r!}.
$$

There are $8$ players, so $n=8.$ We want to select $4$ of those players for the team, so we have $r=4.$

Therefore, the number of different selections of four players is

$$
\begin{aligned}{}_{8}{C}_{4} & =\frac{8!}{(8-4)!\,4!} \\  & =\frac{8!}{4!4!} \\  & =\frac{8\cdot 7\cdot 6\cdot 5\cdot \cancel{4!}}{4!\cancel{4!}} \\  & =\frac{1\,680}{24} \\  & =70.\end{aligned}
$$
